name: Catanduvas (Brazil)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms with a mural crown, a blue shield with cattle, a pine and a landscape, over a scroll reading 16-3 CATANDUVAS 63.
history: Catanduvas is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil, the state's capital of mate. Flags of the World records that the coat of arms is prescribed by Municipal Law No. 177 of 3 August 1971.
